property.name: 17477a69-d9a5-4251-9329-0963e8121b5f
property.value: In this application, integration event handlers are generated by Eventing.Contracts and finished by an AI agent (Intent.Application.Mediator). The subscriptions and actions modelled on this Integration Event Handler (Invoke Command, Publish Integration Event, Send Integration Command and so on) are the specification for each HandleAsync body, in model order. Field mappings are not modelled. Eventing.Contracts silently skips an Invoke and generates a Publish or Send without field mappings as an empty message, so a handler with an Invoke, or with a Publish or Send that has no field mappings, must be finished by hand: take HandleAsync over with Body = Mode.Ignore and write the whole body. Whenever you create this handler, or add, remove, reorder or change any of its subscriptions or actions, check its HandleAsync bodies once the Software Factory has generated them and finish or update them in the same piece of work, using the mediator-integration-event-handler skill. Nothing else will prompt you: no task is raised, and a changed action may change no generated file.
